notes.title: Excoverse - DEMO IS NOW PLAYABLE!
notes.notes:
[h2]The celestials took your daughter. To save her, you must become a monster—without betraying your people.[/h2]

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3039230/1fde714f68061ec288e7fd260592de8347d12d90/ss_1fde714f68061ec288e7fd260592de8347d12d90.jpg?t=1748871201[/img]

[h2]What to expect in the demo?[/h2]
This demo gives you a hands-on look at the upcoming action RPG, Excoverse. Step into the shoes of the noble lord for the first hour of gameplay, featuring:

[list]
[*] [b]Stealth and combat introduction[/b] — Learn the basics of silent takedowns and fast-paced hack-and-slash action.
[*]  [b]Explore the opening area[/b] — Traverse the shadowy forest region, uncover hidden secrets, and meet key NPCs.
[*]  [b]Story preview [/b]— Experience the prologue cutscenes that set the stage for your desperate quest.
[/list]

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3775290/bf10c79cbaacf991de30b52dfa43a6c52515c0d6/ss_bf10c79cbaacf991de30b52dfa43a6c52515c0d6.jpg?t=1748796330[/img]


[h2]When will the full release happen, and what new content will it bring?[/h2]

The full release is planned for 2025. I will announce the exact release date one month before launch. 

Excoverse is a solo-developed passion project. The biggest feature you can expect in the full release is a living, dynamic world. You’ll experience meaningful interactions with NPCs, branching progress shaped by your choices, new skills, and deep character progression — all among the standout elements waiting for you.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3039230/12a36d8957054dfdc51530c2d8e5f652d65731c6/ss_12a36d8957054dfdc51530c2d8e5f652d65731c6.jpg?t=1748871201[/img]
[h2]
Will the demo always be available?[/h2]

[b]No [/b]— the demo will be playable only during special time windows, which I’ll announce before key events and sales.

[h3]So jump in now, play the demo, and leave a review to share your feedback! Your thoughts are truly valuable to me![/h3]
